tasks.title: Liquidation risk on a live lending position
tasks.question: Is Venus position 0x7A38D8bad0591Ad1673E2aB20C67b2c6286982Cd at risk of liquidation, and how much headroom does it have?

hired.label: Venus powered by HeyAnon — MCP getAccountLiquidity
hired.note: Listed on Kawal as hireable. No x402 challenge was issued, so the call was free.

manual.label: Venus Comptroller read directly over RPC
manual.note: Excludes the work of finding and proving the Comptroller address. Kawal spent real effort on that (npm run verify:venues) precisely because published lists name an implementation address that would return nothing here.

tasks.verdict: Doing it yourself was 8.9x faster; both paths returned the same position. Hiring buys convenience, not information.
